reconcile.note: Gill reads friendship as the status Christ's death produces, not a prior condition, so those John calls friends were, until that death, the enemies Paul describes in Romans.

sides.snippet: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
sides.verseText: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

sides.snippet: while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son
sides.verseText: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
